test_is_level_or_label_reference: test the DataFrame _is_level_or_label_reference method for simple label and level references on both axes
test_is_level_reference_ambiguity: test the DataFrame _is_level_reference method when a name is both an index level and a column label
test_check_label_or_level_ambiguity: test the DataFrame _check_label_or_level_ambiguity method raises ValueError when a name conflicts between axis and off-axis
test_get_label_or_level_values: test the DataFrame _get_label_or_level_values method returns correct values for labels, levels, and duplicate labels
test_drop_labels_or_levels: test the DataFrame _drop_labels_or_levels method drops valid labels or levels and raises ValueError for invalid names
